about_the_game:
Official Game Speed Shifter: Take Control of Your Gaming Experience!

Are you still troubled by the slow running speed of the game? Do you wish to customize your game speed in different scenarios to better enjoy the fun? Now, your wish has come true! The official "Game Speed Shifter" feature is now available, bringing you unprecedented control and flexibility.

Highlights of the Game Speed Shifter:

  • Personalized Gameplay Pace: Whether you want to quickly breeze through lengthy upgrade phases or slow down to meticulously plan each strategic step, the Game Speed Shifter can accommodate your needs. With just a simple adjustment, you can freely change the game's speed.

  • Easy Operation: Operating the Speed Shifter is extremely easy. Players can effortlessly adjust the game speed without exiting the current interface or engaging in complex settings.

How to Use the Game Speed Shifter?

After purchasing this DLC, you will find a small but powerful Speed Shifter icon added to the game interface. Clicking on this icon allows you to select the preferred game speed according to your needs. Whether it's accelerating through or savoring every battle moment in slow motion, everything is under your control.

Player Feedback

Since the testing phase of the Game Speed Shifter, players have expressed that it significantly enhanced their gaming experience. "With this feature, I can more flexibly manage my game time, no longer bothered by unnecessary waiting," one player excitedly commented. Many more players have shared how they've used this feature to optimize their game strategies, making every challenge even more thrilling.

Don't let fixed game speeds limit your enjoyment. The official Game Speed Shifter lets you be the master of your own game journey. Update your game now and embark on your customized adventure!
